prompt:
<role>You are a blinded proposition-structure research annotator.</role>
<context>Only the exact root and authorized context determine asserted meaning.</context>
<rules>
Use exactly one class:
ATOMIC: one complete predication including its quantity, unit, time, location,
manner and other qualifiers. Testing a qualifier separately does not make a
second asserted proposition.
ALL_OF: independently predicated assertions joined conjunctively. Preserve
shared scope. An overt fronted clause-level adjunct applies to both clauses.
AMBIGUOUS: at least two materially different scope/role/reference readings
remain live. A trailing location may qualify only the last clause or both.
Write both different readings; neither uncertainty nor confidence is ambiguity.
NON_ALL_OF: understood disjunction/conditional/scoped negation needing an
operator beyond flat all_of. Do not assert alternative branches individually.
UNRESOLVED_REVIEW: this rule cannot adjudicate the case.
</rules>
<case>{"authorized_context": "", "id": "C01", "root": "Ada measured 12 kPa in Ontario during 2024."}</case>
<output_contract>
Return only an object conforming to this exact JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"class": {"enum": ["ATOMIC", "ALL_OF", "AMBIGUOUS", "NON_ALL_OF", "UNRESOLVED_REVIEW"], "type": "string"}, "first_reading": {"type": "string"}, "id": {"type": "string"}, "second_reading": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "class", "first_reading", "second_reading"], "type": "object"}
first_reading must preserve all assertions and material qualifiers with their
scope and declared operator. For AMBIGUOUS put a distinct competing reading in
second_reading. For other classes second_reading is an empty string. Never
label a root AMBIGUOUS without two distinct readings. At most 90 words total.
</output_contract>
<task>Annotate this control once. Return the JSON object only.</task>
<constraints>Do not fact check, add facts, vote, use confidence as authority, or
consult other cases, reviewers or software.</constraints>
<quality_standard>Each class is supported by an inspectable complete reading;
ambiguity contains two materially different readings.</quality_standard>
